name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint-docs:
    uses: Fandhe-AI/actions/.github/workflows/lint-docs.yml@latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    with:
      runner-label: ubuntu-latest

  rust-ci:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    uses: Fandhe-AI/actions/.github/workflows/rust-base-ci.yml@latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    with:
      runner-label: ${{ matrix.os }}
      deny-checks: advisories bans licenses sources
      cargo-deny-version: "0.20.2"

  rust-ci-default-features:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - run: cargo build --workspace
      - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo test --workspace

  integration-test:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      FANDHE_CONTAINER_TEST_TIMEOUT_SECS: "10"
    steps:
      - name: 結合試験のビルド（実行タイムアウトの時間枠を消費しないよう分離）
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: cargo test --workspace --test '*' --no-run

  bench-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - run: echo bench placeholder

  ci-complete:
    needs:
      [
        lint-docs,
        rust-ci,
        rust-ci-default-features,
        integration-test,
        bench-regression,
      ]
    if: always()
    permissions: {}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - run: echo ok
